description: This file defines a GStreamer metadata structure and associated functions for handling protection metadata related to Rialto's EME (Encrypted Media Extensions) protection in a GStreamer pipeline.

classes.name: GstRialtoProtectionMetadata
classes.description: A GStreamer metadata structure for Rialto's EME protection information, extending GstMeta, containing a GstStructure *info.

methods.name: rialto_eme_protection_metadata_get_type
methods.description: Returns the GType for the GstRialtoProtectionMetadata metadata type.

methods.name: rialto_mse_protection_metadata_get_info
methods.description: Returns a GstMetaInfo pointer describing the metadata.

methods.name: rialto_mse_add_protection_metadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer with the provided GstStructure *info.
